title: My Summer Car
provenance: Reported by t0nn-1 (highball-db#225, 2026-09-26), Apple M4, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.33, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, DXMT (the environment's mode), rated 5 of 5 after 6 minutes, with the DLL overrides version=n,b;winmm=n,b;winhttp=n,b set. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on DXMT on an M4 with the steam, corefonts and vcrun2022 recipes. The reporter's environment carried the DLL overrides version=n,b;winmm=n,b;winhttp=n,b, the winhttp one being what the MSCLoader mod loader needs, so that setup counts as a working one on the Wine 10 engine r5. Another report (highball#203) has MSCLoader not loading on r9 with winhttp=n,b, still being looked at. No frame rate was given and nothing was measured here.
